This card supports the SNC-CS50N, SNC-RZ50N, and SNC-RX550N* network cameras. *Compact Adapter required for the SNC-RX550N.</small>
"70-A08811-04S" and "2007/05/17" is silkscreened on the back of the card in the FCC photos.
The card appears to have a MMCX antenna connector in the FCC photos.
